item.title: Capire e utilizzare l'AI per creare: una presentazione divulgativa
item.description:

Come è fatta

item.title: 📖 Book review: "Why Programs Fail" by Andreas Zeller
item.description:
Why Programs Fail: A Guide to Systematic Debugging (Andreas Zeller)

🪲 How do you debug a software issue? For me, it has always been a combination of staring at the program code very intensely, collecting evidence from past runs, intuition, and a lot of trial and error: keep changing things until the problem disappears.

🔬 Can we evolve past these “random”, unguided approaches, and debug a program using the scientific method? After all we’re software engineers, and the distinctive quality of engineers is the use of scientific principles to design and build systems.

item.title: Ethereum for computer scientists
item.description:
On June 6th, 2022, I held a seminar at Università degli Studi di Milano about Ethereum: virtual currency, state machines, and programmable money.

The presentation is about Ethereum from the point of view of a computer scientist. It discusses Ethereum’s global state, the consensus mechanism, smart contracts, ERC20, and more.

The slides are publicly available (Google Sheets; PDF).
